description: This header file declares functions related to Wi-Fi interface parameters, radio interface statistics, neighboring access points, and harvester initialization. The functions facilitate getting and setting configuration parameters, validating, committing, and rolling back changes, indicating it's part of a module managing Wi-Fi and network interface data.
